## Workshops and Tutorials

Researchers and practitioners are invited to submit proposals for workshops and tutorials held in conjunction with ABZ 2027. Workshops and tutorials will be held on June 14-15, 2027 (right before the main conference). Proposals are solicited in areas related to the conference topics.

A workshop proposal should contain the title and acronym of the workshop, the contact information of the workshop organizers, a short abstract for ABZ 2027 website (if accepted), a description of the workshop, the intended format (regular paper presentations, invited talks, panel discussions, breakout sessions, etc.), the expected number of participants, and the duration (half-day or full-day).

A tutorial proposal should contain the title of the tutorial, the contact information of the tutorial presenters, a short abstract for ABZ 2027 website (if accepted), a description of the tutorial, the intended format (lectures, hands-on sessions, group activities, etc.), and the duration (half-day or full-day).

### Important Dates

|                          |                       |
|--------------------------|-----------------------|
| **Workshop and tutorial proposals:** | December 7, 2026      |
| **Notification:**        | January 11, 2027        |

### Submission Process

Workshops and tutorial proposals should be submitted directly to [alcino@di.uminho.pt](mailto:alcino@di.uminho.pt).
